items.informal_name: Sum of Zero Function in Finite Support is Zero
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {h : α → M → N},
  Finsupp.sum 0 h = 0
items.informal_description: For any finite support function from $\alpha$ to a type $M$ with zero element, and for any function $h : \alpha \to M \to N$ where $N$ is an additive commutative monoid, the sum of the zero function (which maps all elements to zero) using $h$ is equal to the zero element of $N$. In symbols, $\sum 0 \, h = 0$.

items.informal_description: The content of the zero polynomial in the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ is equal to zero, i.e., $\operatorname{content}(0) = 0$.

items.informal_name: Mahler Measure of the Zero Polynomial is Zero

items.informal_name: Hilbert Polynomial at Degree Zero is Zero

items.informal_name: Zero Polynomial Evaluation: $0(x) = 0$
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (x : α → ℕ), 0 x = 0
items.informal_description: For any exponent vector $x$, the zero polynomial evaluated at $x$ is equal to 0, i.e., $0(x) = 0$.

items.informal_name: Cauchy Bound for Polynomial Roots
items.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedDivisionRing K], Polynomial.cauchyBound 0 = 1
items.informal_description: For any non-zero polynomial $ p $ over a normed division ring $ K $, every root $ \alpha $ of $ p $ satisfies $ \|\alpha\| \leq 1 + \frac{\sup_{0 \leq i < \deg p} \|\text{coeff}_i(p)\|}{\|\text{leadingCoeff}(p)\|} $, where the supremum is taken over all non-leading coefficients of $ p $.

items.informal_name: Sum of Zero Polynomial is Zero in Additive Commutative Monoid
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (f : ℕ → R → S), Polynomial.sum 0 f = 0
items.informal_description: For any additive commutative monoid $S$ and function $f : \mathbb{N} \to R \to S$, the sum of the zero polynomial in $R[X]$ evaluated through $f$ equals the zero element of $S$. Formally, $\sum_{n \in \text{support}(0)} f(n)(0) = 0_S$.

items.informal_name: Zero Polynomial Maps to Zero Function under Coefficient Extraction
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.toFn n) 0 = 0
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$ and semiring $R$, the coefficient extraction map $\text{toFn}_n$ sends the zero polynomial in $R[X]$ to the zero function in the space of functions from $\{0, 1, \ldots, n-1\}$ to $R$. In other words, $\text{toFn}_n(0) = 0$, where the left-hand side is the zero polynomial and the right-hand side is the function constant zero on all indices $0 \leq i < n$.
